reader_question: Which single action is permitted right now, and what record proves the last one happened?
communication_intent: show the command boundary, rail authorizer, bounded operation, ledger append, state update, and refusal loop

accessibility.alt_text: A command plus reconstructed project context enters the rail authorizer; a permitted step performs one bounded operation, whose artifact is appended to the hash-chained ledger before project state is updated. A refusal returns a finding instead.
